conclusion.summary_ru: В новом optional N+50 output подтверждённых ошибок кода не найдено. Смещения, строгие сравнения, MAXSS и порядок допустимых alias-записей соответствуют проверенным локальным байтам. Это не доказательство полного consumer или runtime-достижимости.

findings.title: Distinct position, marker and side50 output arguments
findings.detail: Four saved registers plus 0x24 local bytes give a 0x34 prologue displacement. The restored body frame uses actor argument at ESP+38, external Vec3 sink at +3C, marker pointer at +40, optional scalar pointer at +44. EBP is the resolved N pointer. There is no swapped marker/side50 argument. Entry and +3C loads were freshly decoded in addition to the four supplied windows; ownership/runtime identity is not inferred.

findings.title: Initialization masks compare elapsed, preserve quiet-NaN path and signed zero
findings.detail: The code computes elapsed=now-float(N+14), then binary32 scale*elapsed. elapsed<0 selects +0; 0.75<elapsed selects 1; otherwise scaled survives. Both comparisons are strict and ordered, matching CMPLTSS masks. In particular -0 is not negative and its scaled sign survives; unordered masks preserve scaled NaN. Disabled option returns 1 without reading N+14/now. The documented FP-environment exclusions are required and not silently closed.

findings.title: MAXSS second operand is current output, not the original input or N+50
findings.detail: Original MAXSS destination initially contains N+50 and source is [side50_output]. C++ record_value>output_value ? record_value : output_value correctly selects the second operand on equality and unordered, including signed-zero ties and either quiet-NaN operand. Tests inspect NaN payload and zero sign in both operand orders. This is not std::fmax semantics.

findings.title: Copy/inactive/marker-gate exits run merge only; clear/missing-record bypass both side50 stores
findings.detail: The finish lambda faithfully merges without age initialization for normal joins at DB2E. The marker gate is ordered 0>=N+48: quiet NaN does not reject, signed zero does. Clear and missing-record paths jump past DB4C and only clear marker output when present. If the two external scalar pointers coincide, that marker clear still changes their shared storage; tests explicitly cover this. No side50 merge is invented on these bypasses.

findings.title: Permitted shared external scalar observes initial store, marker copy, then MAXSS
findings.detail: Positions are stored before preliminary side50 initialization. finish then copies N+48 before rereading the current side50 output for MAXSS. Thus shared external marker/side50 storage correctly discards the preliminary value before merge. Tests distinguish this with preliminary=1, marker=0.28125, N+50=0.5 and with a NaN marker. Existing marker_output==&N.validity_marker self-copy is safe to omit because side50_output cannot alias N under the contract.

findings.title: Initialized external scalar and disjoint-storage restrictions are reasonable bounded API assumptions
findings.detail: Merge-only early exits read incoming output, so an initialized valid float is necessary on those paths. Excluding N/vector/input aliases while permitting exact external scalar sharing is an explicit supported domain, not a missed universal alias implementation. It does not assert the original caller never aliases these objects. Partial overlap, observable memory faults, signaling NaN, MXCSR flags/traps and FTZ/DAZ remain unproven.

findings.title: Missing provider observation is explicitly synthetic and skips side50 stores
findings.detail: trace_observation_missing has no original normal exit counterpart and is named as such in evidence/header. Existing marker-copy behavior is retained while new side50 stores are skipped. This is an explicit partial-model result, not an asserted faithful original branch; aliases can still reflect marker stores. Planned trace/geometry renames do not change this conclusion.

findings.title: No explicit shared-scalar normal early-copy regression in the current test
findings.detail: Separate-output early-copy/merge behavior and shared-output successful/clear/missing/synthetic paths are tested. An exact shared marker/side50 scalar on a normal copy-marker early exit is not explicitly exercised. Static code inspection confirms the same marker-copy-before-MAXSS finish sequence, so this is only a nonblocking coverage observation, not evidence of a bug or a request to expand scope.
